note: Script NPCs, functions, shops and duplicates of them from npc/<mode>/scripts_main.conf, in the order rAthena loads them, with the unique names npc_parsename gives (as in warps.json). Lines on maps the map server does not load are left out. Script NPCs are kept from the folders in script_folders only, below npc/, npc/re/ and npc/pre-re/; left_out counts the others by folder. Shops and functions are kept from every folder. kind is script, function, or a shop type. display is the name players see, and sprite the view as the line writes it. xs and ys are the OnTouch span, -1 without one. state is enabled unless w2 sets (CLOAKED), (HIDDEN) or (DISABLED). script is the text from '{' to the matching '}'. A duplicate names its source in duplicate_of and has no script of its own; a duplicated shop repeats the source's items. shop.items have the item's AegisName and ID and the price, where a price below 0 in the line is the item's buy price (item_prices.json) in shop and marketshop lines. shop.discount says whether Discount and Compulsion Discount lower the prices (npc_shop_discount). shop.currency is the item of an itemshop or the variable of a pointshop. marketshop items have a stock, -1 for unlimited.
